summary: 26-year-old unroped climber fell ~600-800 ft while traversing Broadway Ledge near Fields Chimney on the east face of Longs Peak (the Diamond).
location: Broadway Ledge / Fields Chimney, east face of Longs Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: RMNP rangers; Northern Colorado Interagency Helitak; Boulder County Coroner
notes: Dillon Blanksma, 26, of Golden, a climbing instructor; fall witnessed by another climbing group; body flown to Upper Beaver Meadows helispot ~3:45pm.
